title: poikilospermum oblanceolatum
intro: Poikilospermum oblanceolatum, commonly known as the Red Stemmed Poisonwood, is a plant species native to the tropical regions of the Pacific and Southeast Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Poikilospermum oblanceolatum include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to alleviate pain, reduce fever, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as analgesia, anti-inflammatory response, and immunomodulation.
